name: Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: Established residence in Somalia for at least 7 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years' established residence in Somalia.

requirements.blocker_text: Must declare willingness to renounce foreign citizenship status.

requirement_groups.name: Reduced residence period for the child of a Somali mother

requirements.blocker_text: The 7-year residence requirement is reduced to 2 years where the applicant is the child of a Somali mother, even if she herself is not (or is no longer) a Somali citizen.

evidence_required.document: Declaration of renunciation of foreign citizenship
Proof of Somali maternal parentage (reduced-period track)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 7 years' established residence (2 years if the child of a Somali mother)

sources.title: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative -- Somali Citizenship Law No. 28 of 22 December 1962: Article 4 naturalization criteria (7 years' established residence, good civil and moral conduct, declared willingness to renounce foreign citizenship); Article 5 reduces the residence period to 2 years for the child of a Somali mother; Article 10 provides for loss of Somali citizenship on voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship, formal renunciation, or continued foreign government service after notice; Article 11 allows deprivation of grant-based citizenship obtained by fraud

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). STATUS: DRAFT -- only an NGO-hosted (Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative) consolidated text of the 1962 Law was located; no tier-1 Somali-government-hosted copy was found. LIVE STATUTORY-VS-CONSTITUTIONAL CONFLICT, DISCLOSED RATHER THAN RESOLVED: the 1962 Law's Article 10 says a Somali who voluntarily acquires foreign citizenship LOSES Somali citizenship. But Article 8 of Somalia's 2012 Provisional Constitution (the current supreme law) explicitly states a person 'cannot be deprived of Somali citizenship, even if they become a citizen of another country' -- i.e. the constitution appears to override the 1962 statute's renunciation-on-foreign-naturalization rule and affirmatively guarantee dual citizenship, though Article 8 itself defers detailed acquisition/loss rules to a citizenship act Parliament was supposed to pass. A draft Citizenship Bill was written in 2015-2017 (with technical support from the NGO Legal Action Worldwide) specifically to implement Article 8, but no source located in this build confirms it was ever enacted -- meaning the 1962 Law likely remains the operative statute on paper, sitting in direct tension with the newer constitution's dual-citizenship guarantee, a genuinely unresolved legal question this dataset does not adjudicate. dual_citizenship_allowed is set to TRUE here, following the 2012 Constitution (the supreme law) over the 1962 statute's contrary text -- flagged explicitly as a judgment call, not a certainty. POLITICAL CONTEXT: 'established residence' for 7 years is itself a live question given Somalia's decades of state fragility, Al-Shabaab territorial control, and Somaliland's separate de facto jurisdiction -- this dataset does not attempt to resolve how residence would be documented or verified in practice.
